Built on the right foundations

Payment security starts
with your approved setup.

Your hardware, processor and operating practices each play a part in protecting card data.

PCI

Card data standards

Card data is handled through the approved processor. Merchants maintain their own PCI responsibilities.

EMV

Chip & contactless

Supported terminals accept EMV and contactless payments as configured with the processor and hardware vendor.

TLS

Encrypted connections

Encrypted transmission for connected website forms and supported integrations where applicable.

VENDOR

Vendor certifications

Relevant PCI, EMV and security certifications belong to the processor or hardware vendor.

Let's clear things up

A few questions.
Clear answers.

From choosing your first terminal to moving your existing setup, here's what to expect.

Have something else in mind?

Yes. We size your recommended setup around checkout volume, inventory needs and budget. A single location may need one terminal, while a multi-location business may need centralized management and more devices.

Start with your workflow. Clover offers a broad software ecosystem, NRS focuses on retail workflows such as grocery, convenience and fuel, and PAX offers flexible payment hardware. Exact features depend on the selected configuration.

Sometimes. Compatibility depends on your current software, gateway, processor and device. We confirm integration support before you order equipment.

Timing depends on merchant approval, shipping, hardware availability, catalog or menu setup, and integrations. Once your configuration is confirmed, we can discuss an expected schedule.

Yes. U.S.-based support is available for setup and technical questions. Your merchant agreement sets out the scope of support included in your service.

Your price depends on hardware, software, processing volume, business category, locations and integrations. Your quote will detail hardware and software charges, processing terms, and recurring or one-time fees before you commit.
